title: Stackwave
tagline: Every slab you misjudge, you lose forever.
description: Slabs sweep across the tower; drop each one where it overlaps the last. What hangs over the edge is sheared off and falls, so the tower narrows until a single mistake ends it. Land one dead centre and you get the width back.
author: HexCave
controls: Space, click or tap to drop
howToPlay: A slab sweeps back and forth above the tower. Press space, click, or tap to drop it.
Only the part that overlaps the slab below survives — the overhang is sheared off and falls away.
That means the tower can only get narrower, so every drop matters more than the last.
Land one within a hair of dead centre and you get a little width back, which is the only way to recover.
Miss the tower completely and the run is over.
The sweep gets faster the higher you build.
goal: Stack as many slabs as you can. Height is the score, and your best is kept.
